scope: Synchronous CPU int32 tensor literals and checked ranked elementwise operations through MLIR/LLVM and private checked native interfaces.

semantics.types: Explicit Tensor[int32,...] contexts alongside float32 tensors, with fixed/dynamic extents; no implicit element conversions.
semantics.literals: Each leaf uses existing int32 range/context checks; signed minimum and values beyond float32 precision remain exact. Nested data and constant flat-data shapes reuse existing validation.
semantics.operations: Unary +/- and binary +,-,*,/,% preserve int32. Tensor/tensor ranks/extents match; scalar lifting works in either order without tensor broadcasting.
semantics.arithmetic: Scalar and elementwise operations call the same checked int32 MLIR helper methods; i64 intermediates, zero guards, int32 bounds and narrowing retain accepted overflow/division rules.
semantics.empty: No element operations execute for an empty tensor, including division/remainder by scalar zero.
semantics.faults: Checked faults retain operation spans, terminate the invocation and publish no result. Shape checks precede arithmetic. Invocation ownership settles partial allocations.
semantics.ownership: Borrowed inputs, offsets and aliased operands remain immutable. Ranked result construction and native interface types carry int32 instead of float32.
semantics.static_analysis: Literal/scalar constant checks retained; no aggregate tensor constant folding or interprocedural evaluation introduced.
semantics.remaining: Integer tensor task modules/handoff explicitly gated; integer reductions/matmul rejected with S053 and operand-aware backend checks. Metal, conversions and additional source arithmetic types remain gated. No new tensor CLI display or public foreign-memory API.

coverage: all five binary operators with tensor/tensor and both scalar orders
19x19 signed boundary pairs and 1000 deterministic random pairs per arithmetic program
nontrivial dense ranked shapes and every empty dimension
offset borrowed descriptors and aliased inputs
later-element arithmetic faults and no published partial result
allocation failure and balanced invocation cleanup
literal ranges, ragged/mismatched shapes and mixed type rejection
full prior CPU scalar/task and Apple GPU numerical/lifecycle regression

distributed_execution: Not implemented; separate design-review gate retained in docs/roadmap.md.
performance: Correctness/type integration milestone; no tensor performance or speedup claim.
